# NEW 2026-11-21 v9.9 Worker 2: 4 Colonial Charter Goals & Frontier Pacing 2.0 (oe_col2_). Generated by gen_v99_colonization.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Event-driven additive hooks (zero monthly/yearly pulse overhead, zero vanilla file overrides).
# Strictly rebel-guarded per fx17.

on_game_start = {
	on_actions = { oe_col2_game_start_prefs }
}

oe_col2_game_start_prefs = {
	effect = {
		oe_col2_assign_exploration_prefs = yes
	}
}

on_colonial_charter_finished = {
	on_actions = { oe_col2_on_charter_finished }
}

oe_col2_on_charter_finished = {
	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		num_locations > 0
	}
	effect = {
		# If a vanilla charter finished without setting oe_col2_last_colony_loc, bind an overseas/frontier location safely.
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col2_last_colony_loc } }
			random_owned_location = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						is_overseas_for_owner = yes
						oe_col2_in_steppe_siberia_zone = yes
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = oe_col2_fallback_loc
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:oe_col2_fallback_loc }
				set_variable = { name = oe_col2_last_colony_loc value = scope:oe_col2_fallback_loc }
			}
		}
		oe_col2_dispatch_native_diplomacy = yes
	}
}
